title: Device maintenance.
officialText:
The overpressure protection device shall be properly maintained and inspected every two years by a
Licensed Master Plumber and inspection records shall be maintained by the Owner and made available for the Department; and
inspection procedures shall be in accordance with the commissioner; and replacements or repairs shall be promptly made.
Exception: Where the gas pressure is 15 psig (103 kPa gauge) or above, the overpressure protection device shall be inspected
annually.
